anchors.description: Vertical distance on the sunlit ground-floor brick wall between the two arched windows (x~940): from the centre of one wide red decorative brick band (y~465) down to the centre of the fourth wide red band (y~675). The decorative banding period is 8 brick courses (3 red + 2 cream + 1 red + 2 cream, measured from the colour profile), so the span is 32 brick courses.
anchors.visible_evidence: Redness profile of the brick wall at x=930-950 px shows five wide red bands at y~456-473, 506-524, 558-576, 612-630, 666-685, each separated by a two-course cream band and one thin red course; the two chosen band centres are 210 px apart and span exactly four full 8-course banding periods (32 courses).
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Exact historic brick format is not measurable; assumed 19th-century German NF/RF clay brick with 75-83 mm course module including mortar (0.075-0.083 m/course). Band-period counting could be off by one course per period.
